newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinian dies of wounds after West Bank clash.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian dies of wounds after West Bank clash.

text.p: A Palestinian youth shot in the head by Israeli troops during a West Bank clash this week died on Wednesday, hospital officials in the West Bank town of Ramallah said.
Some 2,000 mourners attended the youth's funeral later in the day in his home village of Seir, near the West Bank flashpoint of Hebron.
"Ashraf Abdel Rahman Matour, 16 years old, died from a bullet in the head today," Samer Anabtawi, administrative director of Ramallah hospital, told Reuters.
Matour was critically wounded when stone-throwing Palestinians clashed with Israeli troops on Monday in the West Bank village of Beit Sahour near PLO-ruled Bethlehem.

Mourners at Matour's funeral carried Palestinian flags and chanted his name, pledging to "carry on the struggle", witnesses said. Among the mourners were senior officers in the PLO-led Palestinian security forces.
The West Bank and Gaza have been tense since Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu broke ground on a new Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem four months ago.
Sporadic violence has flared for weeks in Hebron, where last month a Jewish woman kindled Moslem Arab rage by putting up posters depicting Islam's Prophet Mohammad as a pig.
